feedback: Frank's confession follows the pre-vote contradiction cleanly: approved design and installed support were different, so his asserted physical barrier was false. His access during the preview is newly admitted rather than independently demonstrated, but the open preview, later private-place visit and source poison were already available. I do not regard that admission as a new decisive clue required to choose him. The final line about his name remaining on the plans gives the confession a personal consequence instead of merely reciting chemistry. Chip and Elle resolve their competing lies coherently, though both have another polished self-reproach. The result feels earned as a logic-puzzle ending, somewhat less earned as an emotional decision to murder over professional coercion.
